name: deck-studio
description: Shape, create, revise and publish audience-ready communication decks.

interface.longDescription: Turn notes, approved content or an existing deck into audience-ready local HTML and PDF, with 56 visual systems and rendered inspection. Requires a local executor, Node.js 20+, npm, Python 3.9+ and explicit package-owned Chromium setup. PDF pages are slide images, not editable or searchable text. Optional self-hosted galleries use your own library, access policy and gateway; installation publishes nothing and includes no hosted account. Removing the plugin preserves your decks and independently running services.
defaultPrompt: Use Deck Studio to shape my material into a clear, well-designed deck for its audience.
